title: Among uncommon cards from sets that have Japanese translations, find the on
question: Among uncommon cards from sets that have Japanese translations, find the one with the highest converted mana cost and return its name along with the percentage of those sets that are online-only.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_049,
       (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN s2.XCL_101 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
        FROM sets s2
        INNER JOIN set_translations st2 ON s2.XCL_099 = st2.XCL_093
        WHERE st2.XCL_092 = 'Japanese') AS percentage_online_only
FROM cards c
INNER JOIN sets s ON c.XCL_063 = s.XCL_099
INNER JOIN set_translations st ON s.XCL_099 = st.XCL_093
WHERE c.XCL_059 = 'uncommon'
  AND st.XCL_092 = 'Japanese'
ORDER BY c.XCL_011 DESC
LIMIT 1
